preprocess_image_random_crop: apply random crop preprocessing to an image using preprocess_image_fn with the random_crop option
preprocess_image_pass_through: pass an image through preprocess_image_fn with no preprocessing to return it unchanged
preprocess_metadata_pass_through: pass dataset metadata through preprocess_metadata_fn to return it unchanged
random_crop_image_to_standard: crop an image to 64x64 pixels using _random_crop_image with a random seed
review_preprocessing_module: review the preprocessing module functions for image and metadata preprocessing capabilities
